Name: With a side of Mayo
Author: BenTGI
Description:
[size=6]With a side of Mayo.

With a side of mayo, adds over 10 new dishes that are based on the base game's cooking recipes with the added ingredent of mayo! 

They are sold by Gus when he has 3 hearts with the farmer. 

Credits and thanks:
Stardew valley discord server (modded farmers) for existing
ConcernedApe for the base game cooking recipes.
